name: OBS Studio
description: Windows updater validates packages only via a Blake2b hash inside an unsigned JSON manifest from the same HTTPS endpoint — no signature, no pinned key. WinVerifyTrust guards only the incidental VC++ redist.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: OBS Studio’s inspected Windows updater compares file content with BLAKE2b metadata. This supports an integrity-control observation; metadata authentication and complete platform signing policy remain unestablished.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
Released Windows manifest algorithm, installer/redist validation, and TLS defaults were not audited.
No conclusion is made about other OBS update paths.
